expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Removes the binding identified by the generic input-binding handle. Removes the supplied enhanced action-event binding. Removes the supplied enhanced action-value binding. Removes the supplied debug-key binding. Binds a dynamic delegate to an input action trigger event. @param Action Input action asset to observe. @param TriggerEvent Trigger phase that invokes Delegate. Binds value polling for an input action and returns the stable binding record. expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Use the returned reference in a follow-up mutation or identity check to prove aliasing. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
